project_info.theme: Alternance salary table in France from June 1, 2026
project_info.color_palette: Navy Blue, Red, White, Soft Money Green Gray

main_subject.detail: A clear wage-table infographic explaining alternance salaries in France from 01/06/2026, featuring a centered headline, a navy subheader for second training year, and a three-column table by student age, SMIC percentage, and gross monthly salary.
main_subject.style: Structured labor-information poster with soft blurred money background and a crisp red-navy-white data table.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality salary infographic poster for alternance programs in France. Centerpiece is a three-column wage table showing student age, SMIC percentage, and gross monthly salary, topped by the headline 'MỨC LƯƠNG ALTERNANCE TẠI PHÁP (CHƯƠNG TRÌNH VỪA HỌC VỪA LÀM) TỪ 01/06/2026'. Background is a softly blurred money-themed photo. Surrounding elements: VFE logo, navy section bar 'ĐỐI VỚI NĂM HAI ĐÀO TẠO', four age rows, and source note from Code du travail numérique. Technical style: educational wage-table infographic poster, crisp tabular contrast, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
